defects.description: The site query parameter is interpolated into the SQL text with % formatting and executed as-is. A request with site set to a quote-terminated fragment plus OR 1=1 returns every row in samples, and a stacked or UNION payload can read other tables.
download_report loads owner_id but never compares it with the requester. Any caller who knows or enumerates a report id receives that report file, including reports owned by other analysts.

The path route accepts any string including slashes and joins it onto UPLOAD_ROOT without normalisation or containment check. A filename such as ../../etc/passwd resolves outside the upload root and send_file serves it.
